leads.claim: The document provides instructions to military personnel to secure signed statements and obtain fragments or physical evidence of UAP incidents whenever possible.
leads.why: This is a standard operating procedure for reporting unidentified aerial phenomena and does not confirm the existence or possession of anomalous material.

doc_verdict: This document is a collection of administrative reporting instructions and standard operating procedures for UAP sightings; it contains no evidence that the government or its contractors ever located, obtained, or analyzed physical UAP material.
